description: This file defines a 'namer' package for generating plural forms of type names, with different naming conventions (public, private, lowercase) and handling of exceptions and pluralization rules.

classes.name: pluralNamer
classes.description: A struct that holds exception mappings and a finalize function for generating plural names.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the plural form of a type's name, applying rules and exceptions.

methods.name: iesPlural
methods.description: Converts a singular to its 'ies' plural form.

methods.name: vesPlural
methods.description: Converts a singular to its 'ves' plural form.

methods.name: esPlural
methods.description: Converts a singular to its 'es' plural form.

methods.name: sPlural
methods.description: Converts a singular to its 's' plural form.

methods.name: isConsonant
methods.description: Checks if a character is a consonant.
